lines: Sorrowful desire reaches out, keeping on dreaming
Within eyes painted with lies, the truth remains hidden
Swallowed by the brink of hope
The genuine answer that has sunk
While still searching
A hundred times I’ll cast my wish in the shadow of whatever blocks me
Until the day I surely tell you
Because I cannot surrender righteousness, I keep moving forward
Wandering countless times, aiming onward
Until the day we return to the dawn
I draw a prayer in the hurting mire
Telling myself there’s no worry, I step forward now
I walk the road stitched from cold promises’ pictures
While my heart trembles, fearing there’s no place to breathe in overlapping dreams
My pulse seeks light, choosing a constrained orbit
Even if that torments the present
There won’t be another chance!
A world that shines, desired foolishly
Even if it crushes me when I hold it
Though regret repeats to the point of astonishment, I’ve done it
I won’t let the truth be lost any more
Trapped within a twisted fate
I’ll walk the wild life together with you
Crossing night again, knowing the end of tears lies elsewhere
The great dream we saw when we first met
Each of our lenses held a different scenery
Yet somehow it looked beautiful to us, tightening our hearts
I still remember the helpless urge to scream
That theme alone is perfectly sufficient
Chasing a beautiful question with limited feet forever
“Nothing is wrong,” I sing, voice trembling
“I’ll lead your hand,” if I can survive this moment
Let’s embark on a deep, deep journey (the road ahead may be mostly sin)
Let’s record an endless map
Circling the blue, blue star (everyone surely knew we must never stop)
Even suffering I drag along
Into the depths
A hundred times I’ll cast my wish in the shadow of whatever blocks me
Until the day I surely tell you
Because I cannot surrender righteousness, I keep moving forward
Wandering countless times, aiming onward
Until the day we return to the dawn
I draw a prayer in the hurting mire
Telling myself there’s no worry, I step forward now
To seize the single sunrise
